nyha_class.why: Same date, two assessments: EP consult 09/24 'NYHA class II' (page 2) and HF clinic 09/24 'NYHA class IV' with rest dyspnea and volume overload (page 4). Neither is later. The 10/01 note only cites the EP consult and is not a new assessment. Class II passes rule 4; class IV fails it.

action_reasoning: Rule 4 turns on NYHA class, and the packet has two contradictory same-day assessments (II and IV). Neither is newer, so the 'later wins' rule cannot settle it. A person must decide (and should also check clinical stability). Verify.
